_ai_assisted: AI-assisted: protocol structure regenerated with Codex under Edu decisions for #137; human review pending.
_integration_status: Activated for confirmed numerical findings. Immediate clinical-priority entry before measurement confirmation remains a separate owner integration; no numerical finding automatically establishes urgency.

w_red_flags.text: Let's check the warning signs first. In either eye, is there a new visual-field gap, central distortion, a need for correction beyond what is available, sudden vision loss, severe eye pain, or a severe headache with neurological signs?
w_red_flags.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; SANS consensus, 2026 [6]; Team triage guide [P]

w_notify.text: Time to bring in the crew medical officer. Notify them, then agree together on your check-ups and who's responsible for each one.
w_notify.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, watch: initial action [P]

w_acuity.text: Let's put the pieces together. With your clinician, review corrected acuity and your personal baseline for each eye using Check-in results. Review OCT and visual fields when available. And remember, missing or invalid tests must never be treated as normal.
w_acuity.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, watch: initial action [P]

w_correction.text: Stick to prescribed optical correction only, and follow the sleep and habitat procedures. Clearer focus doesn't mean the swelling has resolved. LBNP, thigh cuffs, supplements, and acetazolamide are research or clinician-only options, not automatic SANS treatments.
w_correction.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; SANS consensus, 2026 [6]

w_end.text: Keep following the plan you've agreed on with your clinician. No drug has established rescue efficacy for SANS. Don't start medicines, pressure manipulation, or invasive eye procedures based on this app.
w_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; Team triage guide [P] Pharmaceutical limits: PDF p. 2, sources [5,6]; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, printed pp. 12-13.

u_stop.text: Stop risky tasks and EVA now, and alert the crew medical officer immediately. Record when the symptoms began and which eye is affected. Don't wait for OCT.
u_stop.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, medical urgency: initial action [P]

u_mars_send.text: Transmit the requested case summary to Earth and keep local care going under the pre-authorized protocol. Communication takes time out here, but it must never delay local assessment.
u_mars_send.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; stop/medical-assessment response [P]; communication context: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf . No SANS evacuation rule is inferred. Optional remote support follows local clinician request (Edu-approved workflow [P]); it does not replace immediate on-board care.

u_ground.text: Send the requested case summary to the flight surgeons while local medical care continues. Just to be clear, this app doesn't send messages or authorize transfers.
u_ground.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; stop/medical-assessment response [P]; communication context: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf . No SANS evacuation rule is inferred. Optional remote support follows local clinician request (Edu-approved workflow [P]); it does not replace immediate on-board care.

u_end.text: The clinical review and accepted handover are recorded. Keep following medical restrictions and your follow-up plan. This doesn't mean you're cured or cleared for EVA. Any transfer remains a decision for the clinical and mission teams.
u_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS: implementation and closing rules [P]

u_help.text: You need help now. Request immediate assistance from the crew medical officer, and don't continue the risky task.

w_concern.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), pp. 1-2; numerical concern requires priority review without automatic medical urgency [P].

w_priority_review.text: This finding deserves a closer look. Ask the crew medical officer for a priority medical review. Remember, a concerning number alone doesn't establish medical urgency.

w_missing_data.text: We shouldn't guess about missing results. Tell the crew medical officer which eye results are unavailable or invalid, and arrange an appropriate assessment. If OCT is missing, structural surveillance is incomplete.

u_local.text: Activate the on-board medical lead for an immediate ocular and neurological assessment. Don't assume every acute visual problem is SANS—the clinician decides the appropriate care and restrictions.

u_support.text: One thing to confirm: has the local clinician requested support from Earth while local care continues?
u_support.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; prototype triage/workflow [P]. Optional Earth support in all environments is Edu-approved team workflow, not a universal treatment requirement from the PDF.

u_handover.text: Before we mark this step as done, make sure a clinician has reviewed this episode and accepted responsibility for your ongoing care. Select Done only once that's confirmed. Otherwise, keep this task active and stay assisted.
